paper_title: Attributing Response to Context A Jensen-Shannon Divergence Driven   Mechanistic Study of Context Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
caption: Computational efficiency comparison between our ARC-JSD and Contextcite (n=256 calls) across all datasets and RAG models. Each bar represents the average seconds per sample for ARC-JSD and Contextcite with different RAG models and datasets.
model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the computational efficiency, measured in average seconds per sample, comparing the ARC-JSD and Contextcite methods across various RAG models and datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Models," displaying four models ordered from left to right: Qwen2-1.5B-IT, Qwen2-7B-IT, Gemma2-2B-IT, and Gemma2-9B-IT. The vertical value axis is labeled "Seconds/Sample" and utilizes a linear scale with an implied range from 0 to 100, featuring numeric tick labels from 0 to 80 at intervals of 20, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. For each model, there is a grouped set of six side-by-side bars separated by thin white outlines. Based on the legend, these bars represent specific combinations of method and dataset, and are visually arranged from left to right within each group as follows: ARC-JSD - TyDi QA (dark blue), ARC-JSD - Hotpot QA (medium blue), ARC-JSD - MuSiQue (light blue), Contextcite - TyDi QA (dark orange), Contextcite - Hotpot QA (medium orange), and Contextcite - MuSiQue (light orange). Across the chart, the dark blue ARC-JSD - TyDi QA bars consistently display the lowest values, with the shortest bars located in the Qwen2-1.5B-IT and Gemma2-2B-IT groups at approximately 2 seconds per sample. In contrast, the light orange Contextcite - MuSiQue bars show the highest values within each model group, peaking with the overall tallest bar in the Gemma2-9B-IT group at approximately 89 seconds per sample. Mid-range values include the light blue ARC-JSD - MuSiQue bar for Qwen2-7B-IT at roughly 21, and the medium orange Contextcite - Hotpot QA bar for Gemma2-2B-IT at about 18. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather maintain a consistent categorical order within each model group, and no specific bars are visually emphasized with annotations or bolding.
